title: Desk accessory
summary: A stand, tray, cable guide or holder that sits on or clamps to a desk.

questions.label: What it is for
questions.placeholder: e.g. hold a phone upright while charging
questions.why: The use decides the form and which surfaces are visible.

questions.label: Objects or cables it touches, with sizes
questions.placeholder: e.g. phone 75.6 x 8.3 mm, USB-C plug 12 x 6 mm
questions.why: Every interface needs a measured size.

questions.label: Cable diameter
questions.why: Sets the cable channel and the bend radius.

questions.label: Largest footprint width
questions.why: Limits the base; a wider base is more stable.

questions.label: Largest footprint depth
questions.why: Limits how far it reaches into the desk.

questions.label: Mounting or reach restrictions
questions.placeholder: e.g. desk edge 25 mm thick, must not block a drawer
questions.why: A clamp or a no-go zone changes the whole construction.

load.note: Object weight plus a push when using it.

material.why: Indoor, low load, good surface finish.
material.consider: PETG for parts that flex, such as a clamp or a clip.

checks.name: Cable bend and access
checks.why: The cable fits its channel without a tight bend, and the plug reaches.

checks.name: Base stability
checks.why: It does not tip when the object is in it or when it is touched.

checks.name: Visible surface and seam
checks.why: The face people see is printed cleanly, away from supports and the seam.

checks.name: Contact protection
checks.why: Surfaces that touch the object or the desk do not scratch them.
